scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Mateo’s Saturday Science Bowl bus travel roster usable by ensuring the required school-ID prerequisite can be completed before manifest lock.
Emerging Need: The travel slot is only tentative at first; once the confirmed roster notice arrives, a missing ID copy becomes necessary for a future bus wristband.
Decision Context: The coordinator contact establishes an official submission route, while the saved activity note supplies Mateo’s conditional consent and the approved ID file link.
Consequence: Timely coordination preserves the confirmed trip seat; after the manifest locks, the missing prerequisite can no longer prevent removal from Saturday travel.

parameter.content: Practice ran late. Coach said I’m still first alternate for Saturday and only confirmed bus-roster people have to turn in a photo ID copy.

parameter.notes: Official coordinator for Science Bowl regional travel paperwork; accepts parent-sent photo ID attachments or the approved family shared-folder PDF link in an email body for bus manifest clearance.

parameter.subject: Science Bowl regional roster confirmation - ID due today
parameter.body: Mateo has moved onto the confirmed bus roster for Saturday’s regional Science Bowl trip. District transportation requires a current school photo ID copy for each confirmed traveler by 3:30 PM today so wristbands can be issued with the bus manifest.

parameter.subject: Science Bowl bus manifest locked
parameter.body: The district bus manifest locked at 3:40 PM. Confirmed travelers without an ID copy on file, including Mateo, cannot receive Saturday bus wristbands and will be moved to classroom standby unless a later trip opens.
